name: Akvamarinovoe leto
source:
Summer Camp "Sovenok" is a wonderful place for youth from all over Russia. It survived the collapse of the USSR and has preserved the timeless traditions of the pioneer movement.
What awaits Anton Petrov there, weary from his daily routine? Intrigue, gossip... or perhaps he'll find there his true love?
